note: Data of the figures in src/content/work/figures/two-dimensional-and-confined/, one entry per file. md5 is of the committed file; source_md5 is of the file it was taken from.

fig4a-k-z-density.dat.what: Fig. 4a of Huang et al., Nat. Commun. 11, 1097 (2020): probability density (a.u.) and height above the surface oxygen plane (angstrom) of the K ion, water oxygen and water hydrogen in K-vermiculite; 100 rows, six columns (density, height) x (ion, oxygen, hydrogen)
fig4a-k-z-density.dat.extraction: Rows 2-101 of the sheet, columns A-F, each stored double written back with repr(); read with the standard library (zipfile and ElementTree) because openpyxl is not in the project environment; scripts/tests/test_vermiculite_z_density.py reads the workbook again and asserts the file equals the sheet

fig4b-li-z-density.dat.what: Fig. 4b of Huang et al., Nat. Commun. 11, 1097 (2020): the same three densities above Li-vermiculite

k_oh_vector_angle_layer1_layer2_data.dat.what: Distribution of cos theta (O-H bond and the surface normal) in the first and second contact layers of water on K-vermiculite, columns cos, P(cos theta) layer 1, cos, P(cos theta) layer 2 in arbitrary units; 100 rows, cos between -0.76 and 0.76. Matches sheet Fig. 4c of the Source Data workbook to its rounding (5e-6).

k_hoh_plane_angle_layer1_layer2_data.dat.what: Distribution of cos phi (H-O-H plane and the basal plane) in the first and second contact layers of water on K-vermiculite, columns cos, P(cos phi) layer 1, cos, P(cos phi) layer 2 in arbitrary units; 100 rows from cos -1 to 0.98, mirror-symmetric about 0; the rows from cos 0 up are the sheet's 50. Matches sheet Fig. 4d of the Source Data workbook to its rounding (5e-6).

li_oh_vector_angle_layer1_layer2_data.da.what: Distribution of cos theta (O-H bond and the surface normal) in the first and second contact layers of water on Li-vermiculite, columns cos, P(cos theta) layer 1, cos, P(cos theta) layer 2 in arbitrary units; 100 rows, cos between -0.76 and 0.76. Matches sheet Fig. 4c of the Source Data workbook to its rounding (5e-6).

li_hoh_plane_angle_layer1_layer2_data.da.what: Distribution of cos phi (H-O-H plane and the basal plane) in the first and second contact layers of water on Li-vermiculite, columns cos, P(cos phi) layer 1, cos, P(cos phi) layer 2 in arbitrary units; 100 rows from cos -1 to 0.98, mirror-symmetric about 0; the rows from cos 0 up are the sheet's 50. Matches sheet Fig. 4d of the Source Data workbook to its rounding (5e-6).

data_K.dat.why: Not the data of Fig. 4a. The header names the columns the wrong way round (the first of each pair is the density, the second the height); 100 bins, but the heights run 5.2-11.2 A for the ion where the paper and the sheet have it at 0.7-1.9 A, the ion curve has two peaks 4.7 A apart where the sheet's has one, and the oxygen and hydrogen curves differ bin for bin from the sheet's. Checked 2026-10-07.

data_Li.dat.why: As data_K.dat, against Fig.4b: ion heights 4.0-11.4 A against -0.7-2.4 A in the sheet.
